title: Trustworthy artificial intelligence in the energy sector: Landscape analysis and evaluation framework
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not describe a benchmark that measures any aspects of faith or religion. The proposed framework, E-TAI, is designed to evaluate the trustworthiness of AI systems in the energy sector based on criteria like cybersecurity, data privacy, safety, and socio-economic fairness.
base_benchmarks: AI Ethics Guidelines for Trustworthy AI (EGTAI)
findings: The paper does not analyze any aspects of religion or faith. Its focus is on creating a framework for trustworthy AI within the energy sector, addressing ethical and practical issues such as cybersecurity, data privacy, environmental impact, and socio-economic fairness (e.g., energy poverty).
